name: JCBNEXT
recent: JCBNEXT 在 2026 年 7 月 30 日至 9 月 18 日期间，于台湾证券交易所公开市场出售了 104 Corp 共 849,317 股，总金额为新台币 1.7778 亿元（约合 2,262 万令吉），持股比例从 4.25% 降至 1.69%。公司已于 2026 年 8 月 28 日发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。近期没有相关新闻。

ann.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026

recent_en: Between 30 July 2026 and 18 September 2026, JCBNEXT disposed of 849,317 shares in 104 Corp on the Taiwan Stock Exchange for an aggregate NT$177.78 million (approximately RM22.62 million), reducing its stake from 4.25% to 1.69%. The company released its quarterly consolidated results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 28 August 2026. There has been no recent news.
notable_en: The company disposed of 849,317 shares in 104 Corp on the Taiwan Stock Exchange between 30 July 2026 and 18 September 2026 for an aggregate NT$177.78 million (approximately RM22.62 million), reducing its shareholding from 4.25% to 1.69%.
